question: Why is consciousness itself called the true teacher in this doctrine?
premises: In this guiding principle, consciousness alone is called the teacher.
The teacher is so called because it swallows the universe.
It swallows the universe through the processes of creation and dissolution.
inference: Consciousness is the true guru because it emits and reabsorbs the entire universe.
plain_english: Therefore, in this guiding principle, consciousness alone is called the teacher, because it indeed swallows the universe through creation and dissolution.
